title: DriftGuardRunEvent
description: Schema for DriftGuard run event stream emitted during baseline and healing workflows

run_id.description: Unique identifier of the execution run

sequence.description: Monotonically increasing sequence number within the run

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of event creation

tool.description: Target tool name if event is scoped to a tool call, null otherwise

data.description: Arbitrary event metadata. Secrets must be redacted prior to emission.
